sentences.english: How old is your brother?
sentences.chinese: 你弟弟多大了？

sentences.english: We found an old photo album in the attic with pictures of my grandparents.
sentences.chinese: 我们在阁楼找到一本旧相册，里面有爷爷奶奶的照片。

sentences.english: My car is over fifteen years old, but I still drive it every day because it's reliable and I can't afford a new one yet.
sentences.chinese: 我的车已经开了超过十五年了，但我还每天开着，因为它很可靠，而且我还买不起新车。
sentences.scene: 聊自己开了多年的老爷车

sentences.english: She is very young.
sentences.chinese: 她很年轻。

sentences.english: When I was young, I used to believe I could fly.
sentences.chinese: 我小的时候，曾经相信自己能飞起来。

sentences.english: My grandmother always says that staying young is not about your age but about your attitude and how you see the world.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶总说，保持年轻不在于年龄，而在于心态和你看待世界的方式。

sentences.english: That joke was really funny.
sentences.chinese: 那个笑话真好笑。

sentences.english: My dog makes a funny face every time I say 'treat'.
sentences.chinese: 每次我说零食，我的狗就会做个滑稽的表情。

sentences.english: Something funny happened on my way to work today: a pigeon flew right into the bus window and scared everyone inside.
sentences.chinese: 今天上班路上发生了一件趣事：一只鸽子直接撞到了公交车窗上，把车里的人都吓了一大跳。
sentences.scene: 讲述通勤途中的意外插曲

sentences.english: Thank you, you're very kind.
sentences.chinese: 谢谢，你真好。
sentences.scene: 对别人善意的举动表示感谢

sentences.english: It was kind of the stranger to help me carry my bags upstairs.
sentences.chinese: 那个陌生人帮我把袋子搬上楼，真好心。
sentences.scene: 在楼梯上遇到好心的陌生人

sentences.english: A kind word or a simple smile can really change someone's entire day, so I always try to be nice to everyone I meet.
sentences.chinese: 一句善意的话或一个简单的微笑真的能改变一个人的一整天，所以我总是尽量善待我遇到的每个人。
sentences.scene: 分享以善待人的人生信条

sentences.english: My dad is very strict.
sentences.chinese: 我爸爸非常严格。

sentences.english: The school has strict rules about wearing uniforms and being on time.
sentences.chinese: 学校对着装和守时有很严格的规定。

sentences.english: When I was a teenager, I thought my parents were too strict, but now I understand they just wanted to keep me safe and teach me discipline.
sentences.chinese: 我十几岁时觉得父母太严格了，但现在我明白他们只是想保护我的安全，教会我自律。
sentences.scene: 长大后理解父母的用心

sentences.english: Be polite to your elders.
sentences.chinese: 对长辈要有礼貌。

sentences.english: The waiter was so polite and always had a smile on his face.
sentences.chinese: 那位服务员非常有礼貌，脸上一直挂着笑容。

sentences.english: Even when someone is rude to you, it's important to stay polite and not let their bad mood affect your own behavior.
sentences.chinese: 即使有人对你无礼，保持礼貌也很重要，不要让他们的坏情绪影响你的行为。

sentences.english: She is a hard-working student.
sentences.chinese: 她是个勤奋的学生。

sentences.english: My mom is the most hard-working person I know; she never stops.
sentences.chinese: 我妈妈是我认识的最勤奋的人，她从来都不歇着。

sentences.english: Being hard-working doesn't always mean you succeed right away, but it definitely gives you a better chance in the long run.
sentences.chinese: 勤奋不总能让你立刻成功，但从长远来看，它肯定能给你更好的机会。

sentences.english: The map was very helpful.
sentences.chinese: 那张地图帮了大忙。

sentences.english: It's really helpful to have a friend who understands math.
sentences.chinese: 有个懂数学的朋友实在太有帮助了。
sentences.scene: 感激学霸朋友辅导功课

sentences.english: I found a really helpful tutorial online that showed me how to fix the sink without calling a plumber.
sentences.chinese: 我在网上找到了一个特别有用的教程，教我怎么不用叫水管工就修好水槽。
sentences.scene: 参考网络教程自己动手维修

sentences.english: That's a clever idea!
sentences.chinese: 那是个聪明的主意！
sentences.scene: 听完别人的点子后称赞

sentences.english: The cat was clever enough to open the door by jumping on the handle.
sentences.chinese: 那只猫聪明得能跳上门把手把门打开。
sentences.scene: 讲述自家宠物的机灵行为

sentences.english: My little sister is so clever that she figured out my phone password just by watching me type it once.
sentences.chinese: 我妹妹太精了，她只看我输了一次手机密码就弄明白了。
sentences.scene: 被妹妹的聪明机智惊到

sentences.english: Don't be shy, come say hello.
sentences.chinese: 别害羞，过来打个招呼。
sentences.scene: 鼓励害羞的孩子跟人打招呼

sentences.english: I was too shy to ask the question in class, so I asked the teacher later.
sentences.chinese: 我太害羞不敢在课上提问，所以后来私下问了老师。
sentences.scene: 描述课堂上的害羞心理

sentences.english: When I first started working here, I was really shy and hardly spoke to anyone, but now I've made some great friends among my coworkers.
sentences.chinese: 我刚开始在这儿工作的时候非常腼腆，几乎不和任何人说话，但现在我在同事中交了好几个好朋友。
sentences.scene: 从害羞到融入集体的转变

sentences.english: I know the answer!
sentences.chinese: 我知道答案！

sentences.english: Do you know how to get to the train station from here?
sentences.chinese: 你知道从这儿怎么去火车站吗？

sentences.english: After living in this neighborhood for five years, I feel like I know every street, every shortcut, and the name of every cashier at the grocery store.
sentences.chinese: 在这个街区住了五年后，我感觉我熟悉了每条街道、每条近路，连杂货店每个收银员的名字都叫得出来。

sentences.english: This is our classroom.
sentences.chinese: 这是我们的教室。

sentences.english: We need to paint our fence because the old paint is peeling off.
sentences.chinese: 我们的栅栏得刷漆了，因为旧漆在剥落。

sentences.english: After years of dreaming, we finally bought our first house, and it's a little fixer-upper, but it's completely ours.
sentences.chinese: 经过多年的梦想，我们终于买了第一套属于我们自己的房子，它虽有点破旧，但完全是我们的。

chinese_meaning: 女士（用于婚姻状况不明的女性）

sentences.english: Good morning, Ms. Taylor!
sentences.chinese: 早上好，泰勒女士！

sentences.english: Ms. Ramirez is the new librarian who started at our school last week.
sentences.chinese: 拉米雷斯女士是上周刚到我们学校的图书管理员。

sentences.english: When Ms. Clark announced that our class was going on a field trip to the zoo, everyone started cheering and couldn't stop talking about it for days.
sentences.chinese: 当克拉克女士宣布我们班要去动物园实地考察时，大家都欢呼起来，好几天都停不住谈论这件事。
sentences.scene: 老师宣布好消息引起全班轰动

sentences.english: I will call you later.
sentences.chinese: 我晚点会打给你。

sentences.english: Don't worry, everything will be okay. I promise.
sentences.chinese: 别担心，一切都会好起来的，我保证。

sentences.english: If you study a little bit every day, you will see real progress, and soon you will be able to speak English more confidently.
sentences.chinese: 如果你每天学一点点，你就会看到真正的进步，很快你就能更自信地说英语了。

sentences.english: I sometimes skip breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 我有时不吃早餐。
sentences.scene: 承认自己不太好的习惯

sentences.english: Sometimes, I just want to stay in bed all day and watch movies.
sentences.chinese: 有时候，我就想整天赖在床上看电影。

sentences.english: I usually take the bus to work, but sometimes when the weather is nice, I walk instead because it wakes me up.
sentences.chinese: 我通常坐公交车上班，但有时天气好时我也走路去，因为这样能让我清醒。
sentences.scene: 根据天气变换通勤方式

sentences.english: I want a robot toy.
sentences.chinese: 我想要个机器人玩具。

sentences.english: The factory uses robots to build cars faster and more safely.
sentences.chinese: 那个工厂使用机器人更快速、更安全地制造汽车。
sentences.scene: 介绍现代工厂的自动化

sentences.english: When I was a kid, I dreamed of having a robot that would clean my room and do my homework, but I guess we're not quite there yet.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候梦想有个机器人能打扫我的房间和做作业，不过看来我们离这还有段距离呢。
sentences.scene: 回忆童年对机器人的幻想

sentences.english: I saw him yesterday.
sentences.chinese: 我昨天看到他了。

sentences.english: Can you give him this book? He left it in my car.
sentences.chinese: 你能把这本书给他吗？他落在我车上了。

sentences.english: I asked my dad if I could borrow the car, but I knew from the look on his face that I had better not push him any further.
sentences.chinese: 我问爸爸能不能借车，但从他的表情我就知道最好别再追问了。

sentences.english: Please speak slowly.
sentences.chinese: 请说慢一点。
sentences.scene: 听不懂时请求对方慢说

sentences.english: I was so nervous during the presentation that I could hardly speak.
sentences.chinese: 演讲时我紧张得几乎说不出话来。
sentences.scene: 分享演讲时的紧张经历

sentences.english: After living in Spain for a year, I can finally speak Spanish comfortably, even though I still make mistakes sometimes.
sentences.chinese: 在西班牙住了一年后，我终于能自如地说西班牙语了，虽然有时候还是会犯错。
sentences.scene: 居住国外后语言能力的进步

sentences.english: Let me finish this first.
sentences.chinese: 让我先把这个做完。

sentences.english: I couldn't finish the movie because I fell asleep on the couch.
sentences.chinese: 我没能看完那部电影，因为我在沙发上睡着了。
sentences.scene: 没看完电影的常见原因

sentences.english: Once I finish reading this book, I'm going to start the next one in the series because the story was so gripping.
sentences.chinese: 等我把这本书读完，我就要开始这个系列的下一本，因为这故事太吸引人了。
sentences.scene: 着迷于一本书并计划续读
